capabilities: Render hexcrawl maps from one-hex-per-line text with paths and ring overlays
Lay out dungeon maps from room sizes and connections
Draw pointcrawl and citycrawl maps from linked locations and streets
Pan, zoom, re-center and export maps as PNG
Add custom icon packs as SVG folders
disambiguation: Not a web crawler or site mapper; it renders tabletop RPG crawl maps from text.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; installation requires manually downloading release files into the plugins folder.
intentEvidence: text-mapper code blocks render too, so maps written for Text Mapper or Tag and Tally keep working
problem: Drawing TTRPG crawl maps usually means external tools or image editors; Obsidian has no way to turn plain text into these game maps.

relations.evidence: Text Mapper by Alex Schroeder — the original Perl tool and its map syntax
the TypeScript port to an Obsidian plugin, adding pointy-top hexes
developed inside the Tag and Tally plugin

summary: Renders hexcrawl, dungeon, pointcrawl and citycrawl maps from plain-text descriptions written in Obsidian code blocks.
